== Notes ==
* Does not block [[Pet attack]]s, despite them technically being attack skills. This is because they buff the next attack of their owner's [[pet]] rather than affecting an enemy directly like other attack skills.
{{anomaly|Only blocked attack skills will trigger the secondary effect, adrenaline and energy will not be gained when an [[auto attack]] is blocked (by another blocking source).}}
